description: Fetch the full build prompt for one NightMarquee design, tuned for the target tool. Free prompts need no account; Unlimited prompts need one (run nightmarquee_sign_in).

brand.description: Swap the fictional brand for this name

error.description: Set when the prompt could not be fetched

tool.description: Dialect the text was written for
